fusions.name: Musk Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone 3 tiles ahead that deals 10 damage, knocks enemies 2 tiles back and leaves each [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Marked Prey
fusions.desc: Spits at a target carrying one of your afflictions, dealing 9 damage and using that affliction up.

fusions.name: Foul Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and the attacker is left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Twice
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything other than fire, a jet strikes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 6 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
